messages.text: Decided while you were away: landing `1582c67`, check green (because the one-line fix is the expected outcome: `On_IPurple` is now `\033[0;105m`, the high-intensity purple background, like the other `On_I*` entries). Accepted without a regression test: the check has no colour-value test to join, and a one-escape fix does not warrant a new harness.
